name: DARTsort imec1 saved-output state-conditioned descriptive scorecard v1
objective: Describe how the existing uncurated DARTsort event population and model-derived features vary across the already-frozen Arm-A q states without rereading voltage or rerunning a sorter.

population.curation_status: uncurated; every exported Phy group is unsorted
population.exclusions: negative-label rows only; no unit-quality exclusion
reporting_subsets: common observed-depth support: unit median amortized z_abs in [300,3540] um
state-supported units: at least 100 q0 events and at least 100 displaced events

comparator.primary: within the same DARTsort unit, q0 versus all q!=0 events
comparator.secondary: each exact q state versus q0 within the same unit
comparator.reason: No external arm is equivalent in preprocessing, motion field, curation, or amplitude definition; external arm-to-arm differences would not isolate sorter effects.

common_support.time: one AP-frame-zero segment, samples [0,314204094), fs 29999.759166666667 Hz
common_support.states: exact supplied Arm-A 40-um q lattice, 0.25 s half-open cells; q0 is q==0 and displaced is q!=0
common_support.depth: model-derived observed z_abs column 2; common interior unit support is median z_abs in [300,3540] um
common_support.channels: 383 DARTsort channels after AP191 removal; no interpolation to the missing site
common_support.intervals: within-unit adjacent intervals count only when both events lie in the same contiguous q-state segment and same 300 s block when block summaries are used

metrics.name: event_and_exposure_counts
metrics.definitions: Exposure is the sum of clipped 0.25 s cells by q. Event state uses the frozen event-bin formula.

metrics.name: per_unit_state_rates
metrics.definitions: Ratios use no pseudocount; zero-denominator values are missing and reported.

metrics.name: presence
metrics.definitions: Full recording-local support; final partial 60 s bin retained; 100 equal bins include the complete duration.

metrics.name: refractory_and_segment_safe_intervals
metrics.definitions: Sort events by sample within unit. State-conditioned counts require the same exact q and contiguous q segment. SlidingRP is full-session only and uses the reviewed IBL/SpikeInterface port at the actual fs. Short intervals are contamination proxies only.

metrics.name: dartsort_denoised_ptp_distribution
metrics.definitions: Input is matching1.h5 denoised_ptp_amplitudes: maximum-channel peak-to-peak of the denoised event waveform in noise-normalized recording units. Noise cutoff uses exact IBL histogram arithmetic on this different signal and is always emitted under the renamed field.

metrics.name: amortized_point_source_spatial_distribution
metrics.definitions: Input is point_source_localizations[:,2], a model-derived amortized point-source observed z_abs. No channel index is used as depth and no DARTsort or Arm-A displacement is subtracted in v1.

uncertainty.reason: This is a single-pipeline descriptive audit and event independence is false. Exact counts, unit distributions, medians, IQRs, and denominators are reported instead.
uncertainty.future_extension: Any block bootstrap is a separately frozen redesign and must use exact per-draw amplitude histogram maxima; it cannot reuse the rejected R1 fixed-support shortcut.

interpretation.decision_rule: no production pass/fail and no ranking; emit descriptive tables and flagged data-quality failures only
interpretation.can_support: whether saved DARTsort events/features show state-conditioned changes large enough to motivate a later matched pipeline experiment
cannot_support: original R1 WIU P or K

resource_bounds.stop_condition: stop before outcomes on any input/schema/hash mismatch; stop runtime at two hours preserving partial evidence
